title: Nourishing Pillowy Ukrainian Hummus Dumplings
description: Indulgent Ukrainian dish featuring hummus, lamination-puff, and ayurvedic-sattvic-friendly ingredients, resulting in charred and pillowy dumplings.
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine flour, salt, and yeast.
Gradually add water and mix until a dough forms.
Knead the dough for 10 minutes until it becomes smooth and elastic.
Let the dough rise in a warm place for 1 hour.
Preheat a non-stick skillet over medium heat.
Divide the dough into 8 equal pieces and roll each into a ball.
Flatten each ball into a disk shape and place 1 tablespoon of hummus in the center.
Fold the dough over the hummus and press the edges together to seal the dumpling.
Brush the tops with olive oil and sprinkle with paprika and garlic powder.
Cook the dumplings for 3-4 minutes on each side, until they are charred and pillowy.
